descriptions.zh:
对§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!的地质扫描显示在一个特定的地下区域中，局部的极端温度接近绝对零度。

对内部更详尽的研究将会带来更多的答案。
descriptions.en:
Topographical scans of §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! show extreme temperatures approaching absolute zero localized in a particular subterranean region.

A more detailed study of the interior should yield more answers.

descriptions.zh: §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!的表面几乎完全被一些整齐排列的圆形小池塘覆盖。这种规整的网格表明它们可能是精心设计的而非自然形成。现场调查可能带来更多的解答。
descriptions.en: §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!'s surface is almost entirely covered by a lattice grid of small, circular, liquid-filled pools. Their neat alignment suggests deliberate engineering rather than natural formation. A field expedition may provide more answers.

descriptions.zh: §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!表面居高不下的辐射水平指向了一座破旧的反应堆复合体。这座孤零零的设施似乎废弃已久，有待调查。
descriptions.en: Elevated radiation levels on the surface of §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! were traced to a dilapidated reactor complex. The isolated facility appears inactive and warrants investigation.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!的轨道影像显示了一座破败的采矿设施，周围还有许多被遗弃已久的原始太空货船。

除了这些影像外，我们的短波通讯阵列还拾获了一个来自行星地下深处的非常微弱的求救信号。对该遗址进行更详细的研究将揭示信号的起源。
descriptions.en:
Orbital imaging of §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! has flagged a dilapidated mining facility accompanied by long abandoned rudimentary space faring cargo vessels.

Alongside these images, our shortwave communications array has picked up a very faint distress beacon emanating deep below the planet's surface. A more detailed study of the site will reveal its origins.

descriptions.zh:
对§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!的扫描发现了一艘太空船残骸。这艘飞船似乎在多年以前遭受了非受控着陆。

其巨大的规模表明了建造其所需的巨大资源量。考古发掘可以帮助我们确认其为何坠毁于此。
descriptions.en:
Scans of §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! revealed the presence of a spaceborne shipwreck. The vessel appears to have endured an uncontrolled landing here many years ago.

Its massive scale suggests immense resources were once committed to its construction. An archaeological expedition will help us ascertain how it ended up here.

descriptions.zh:
我们的传感器检测到一个从§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!的撞击坑深处发出的异常通讯信号。

震波拓扑扫描显示存在一个地下洞穴网络，其塌陷的洞口正在撞击坑中心。与此同时，我们的放射仪探测到从该地点发出的微弱的引力辐射痕迹，这带来的问题比答案更多。
descriptions.en:
Our sensors have detected an irregular communications signal emanating from deep within an impact crater on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!.

Seismic topology scans reveal a network of subterranean caverns with a collapsed entrance at the center of the crater. Alongside this, our radiology equipment is detecting faint traces of gravitational radiation emanating from the site, posing more questions than it answers.
